segments.title: How many time zones does CHINA use?
segments.say: China is about as wide as the USA. How many time zones does it use? One, three, or five? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Just ONE!
segments.say: Just one! The whole country runs on Beijing Time.

segments.title: It spans FIVE geographic zones
segments.say: China spans five geographic time zones, but the official clocks all match.

segments.title: Far west? Sunrise can be late
segments.say: So in the far west, the sun can rise late. Some people there also use local Xinjiang time, two hours behind.
Did you guess five? Be honest. Comment below.
